title: Effects of a Moisturizing Product on Dry Eye and Skin
brief_summary: Dry eye is a common syndrome associated with symptoms of dryness, burning, itching and grittiness of eyes. The objective of this study is to investigate the effects of a moisturizing product in liquid formula on symptoms and signs of dry eye and on skin around the eyes.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Dry eye symptoms OSDI score 20 or higher
* Dryness, burning or foreign body sensation moderate or higher

Exclusion Criteria:

* Severe eye diseases
* Known allergy to any of the ingredients of the product
* Laser surgery of eyes during the last year
